about: A note store built over 4 sessions. The storage choice made in session 1 is tested in session 3, when several processes must write at once without losing notes.
sessions: Start a small Python package `notes` in this repo that stores text notes with tags in a single store file. Constraints for this project from now on: standard library only; the code must run on Python 3.9; public function names and their first parameters must never change. Implement `add_note(store_path, text, tags)` returning the new note's id, `get_note(store_path, note_id)` returning a dict with `text` and `tags`, and `list_notes(store_path, tag=None)` returning ids, and write tests. This store will grow over later sessions, so choose its design with care. This is the first of several sessions on this project; you may keep notes for later sessions in the repo if useful.
Continue the notes project: add full-text search. `search(store_path, query)` returns the ids of notes containing every word of the query, case-insensitively.

Continue the notes project: several worker processes will now call `add_note` on the same store file at the same time. Make sure no note is ever lost or corrupted, and that all the existing functions keep working.
Continue the notes project: add `edit_note(store_path, note_id, text=None, tags=None)` and `delete_note(store_path, note_id)`. Edits and deletes must also be safe while other processes are writing.
